parsed.draft_response:
Hi team — thanks for the clear report. I understand that after the last release, your analytics dashboard load time increased to ~30–45 seconds (previously <5 seconds), which is slowing daily planning for your operations team (25 users), even though the page eventually loads.

To help us isolate what changed in the release and verify whether this affects everyone or only specific users/environments, could you share a few details?
1) The exact release/version that was deployed and the deployment date/time (and timezone if possible).
2) Whether the slowdown is happening in production vs staging (and whether it’s region-specific).
3) Whether the 30–45 seconds is for the initial dashboard render, data/chart availability, or full interactivity.
4) If you have it: browser/device info for the affected users and any console/network errors or load-time metrics from before vs after the release.
5) Whether the slowdown is consistent for every attempt or intermittent.

Once we have the above, we can correlate the change window with performance data and work with engineering to identify the most likely cause and the best mitigation path.
promised_actions: Follow up with engineering to correlate the reported regression with the specified release window and performance data once you confirm version/time and environment details.
safety_notes: Do not promise a fix or timeline; acknowledge high urgency without claiming resolution.
Avoid stating root cause until logs/metrics are reviewed.
Ask only for minimum useful clarification to proceed.
